symbols.name: FileSystemCacheStoreProvider
symbols.summary: Owns a native advanced-cache root, checked metadata indexes, immutable payload generations, and durable quota authority.
symbols.remarks: The root belongs exclusively to this cache format. Shared filesystem profiles require their documented native qualification.
